dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, is that a new phone?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, ɪz ðæt ə ˈnuː ˈfoʊn?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes. A thief stole my old phone on a night bus in Cambodia.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ə ˈθiːf ˈstoʊl maɪ ˈoʊld ˈfoʊn ɑːn ə ˈnaɪt ˌbʌs ɪn kæmˈboʊdiə.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh no! What were you doing?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! ˈwʌt wɜːr juː ˈduːɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I was sleeping when he took it from my bag.
dialogue.reading: aɪ wʌz ˈsliːpɪŋ wɛn hiː ˈtʊk ɪt frəm maɪ ˈbæɡ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Are you sure? Maybe you dropped it.
dialogue.reading: ər juː ˈʃʊr? ˈmeɪbi juː ˈdrɑːpt ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No. When I woke up, my bag was open. Then I realized my phone wasn't there.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. wɛn aɪ ˈwoʊk ˈʌp, maɪ ˈbæɡ wʌz ˈoʊpən. ˈðɛn aɪ ˈriːəlaɪzd maɪ ˈfoʊn ˈwʌzənt ˈðɛr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: A woman noticed a man near my seat, but she didn't say anything.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈwʊmən ˈnoʊtɪst ə ˈmæn ˈnɪr maɪ ˈsiːt, bʌt ʃiː ˈdɪdənt ˈseɪ ˈɛniθɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Did you go to the police?
dialogue.reading: dɪd juː ˈɡoʊ tə ðə pəˈliːs?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, but they didn't find him. Now I never sleep on buses!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, bʌt ðeɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈfaɪnd hɪm. ˈnaʊ aɪ ˈnɛvər ˈsliːp ɑːn ˈbʌsɪz!
